title: Comparison of Nutritional Screening Tools in Liver Cirrhosis Patients
official: Comparison of Two Nutritional Screening Tools for the Detection of Malnutrition in Patients with Liver Cirrhosis
summary: This study compares two nutritional screening questionnaires in cirrhotic patients. All patients will be assessed with both questionnaires, besides a complete nutritional assessment.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients diagnosed with liver cirrhosis.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with cognitive impairment or major psychiatric disorder.
* Lack of consent from the patient for inclusion in the study.
* Any patient who is not suitable based on the researcher's own judgement.
